l1_connect_account.title: Bring the cloud clusters run apart under the same management
l1_connect_account.why: Clusters run in the cloud, but they are managed apart from the data centre, so their policies, recovery and cost drift.
steps: List cloud accounts and the clusters in them.
Attach each cluster to the same management as the data centre.
Confirm version, policies and replication show for each.
l1_connect_account.success: Every cloud cluster in scope is managed with the data centre and reports its state.
